title: Wristbands
desc: Terry wristband on the arm neck (local y 0.016..0.104, outer radius 0.156 = 1.04x the arm tip). Authored for the +x arm in arm-local frame; mirror x (flip winding) for the -x arm.

local_frame.origin: arm tip centre B (BobForm.armTip for the +x arm at rest; the posed capsule tip B when posed)

convention: NOT rest space. Mesh is in the ARM-LOCAL frame (origin = arm tip centre B; +y = unit(A-B) toward the shoulder; +x outward = cross(y,+z_body); +z = body forward), authored for the +x arm. restPos(rest pose) = anchor_rest + R*v with R columns in local_frame.rest_matrix_columns; for a posed arm build the same frame from the posed capsule (A,B) and scale by r2/0.15. Mirror x (flip winding) for the -x arm.
deform_class: arm_frame (mirror for -x arm, scale by tip radius/0.15)
